description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing client identity data within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields for identifiers, document type, document key, description, status, and allowed document types. The class uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation and implements Serializable.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierData
classes.description: Immutable data object for client identity information, including identifiers and document data.

methods.name: singleItem
methods.description: Creates a new ClientIdentifierData instance with specified details and no allowed document types.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template ClientIdentifierData instance with provided collection of CodeValueData.

methods.name: template (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates a new ClientIdentifierData instance based on existing data and a collection of CodeValueData.
